model_rnn.add(SimpleRNN(128, activation='tanh', input_shape=(X_train.shape[1], 1)))
model_rnn.add(BatchNormalization())
model_rnn.add(Dropout(0.5))
model_rnn.add(Dense(len(np.unique(labels)), activation='softmax'))
model_rnn.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])


X_train_rnn = X_train.reshape((X_train.shape[0], X_train.shape[1], 1))
X_test_rnn = X_test.reshape((X_test.shape[0], X_test.shape[1], 1))
model_rnn.fit(X_train_rnn, y_train, epochs=30, batch_size=32, validation_data=(X_test_rnn, y_test))


y_pred_rnn_prob = model_rnn.predict(X_test_rnn)


voting_clf = VotingClassifier(estimators=[('svm', svm), ('ffnn', ffnn)], voting='soft')


voting_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred = np.argmax(y_pred_prob, axis=1)

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
